PREQUALIFICATION CRITERIA The bidders shall upload following pre-qualification documents along with their offer as per mentioned in P ART-I of e-tender:

1. Bidder should submit the successfully completed similar works of vibration ana lysis/ in-situ high speed balancing of high speed turbo machineries by using min imum 16 channel vibration analyser in Fertilizers/ Oil and Gas / Petroleum Refin eries / Power sector/steel/ petrochemicals during last 7 years ending last day of month previous to the one in which offers are invited/issued should be fulfilling either of the following :- Minimum value of completed work must be as follows: a) Three similar completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs. 4.94 Lakh each + GST, OR b) Two similar completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs. 6.18 Lakh each + GST, OR c) One similar completed works costing not less than the amount equal to Rs. 9.88 Lakh each + GST. Note :- a) Bidder shall submit executed work order/purchase order copy for fulfilling the above -mentioned criteria. This work order must be issued & executed in the last 07 (seven) years ending the last day of month previous to the one in which this subject tender is floated/issued. 2. Proof of execution of submitted work order, bidders have to submit the following document related to submitted work order (i) Completion Certificate/ Customer Acceptance Certificate OR (ii) GeM SDAC (Service Delivery Acceptance Certificate) document OR (iii) (a) Tax Invoice to the extent of the required Pre-Qualification value and (b) Proof of receipt of payment like bank statement for the above referred tax invoice 03. Contractor should submit the details of the multichannel vibration machine a long with the bid. 04. Copy of partnership deed/proprietorship /Memorandum and article of association, certificate of incorporation. 05. Average annual financial turnover during the last three years, ending 31st March of the previous financial year (i.e. FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) should be at leas t Rs. 3.70 Lakhs. In case the date of constitution/incorporation of the bidder is less than three years old, the average annual financial turnover in respect of the completed financial yea rs after the date of constitution shall be taken into account. In this case, the financi al turnover during last financial year/ the average financial turnover during precedi ng two financial years should be at least Rs. 3.70 Lakhs. Bidders shall submit CA ce rtificate / CA audited Profit & Loss accounts, Balance sheets etc. indicating the ann ual turnover figures, in support of the same. The financial documents has to be CA audited/issued with membership number, seal, signed and with UDIN.

06. Net worth of the bidder should not be negative on 31.03.2026. It means the net worth of the bidder should not be negative in the balance sheet of financial year 2 025-2026. AND Net worth of the bidder should have not eroded by more than 30% (thirty percent) in the last three years, ending 31.03.2026. It means the net worth of financial year 2025- 2026 should not be less than 70% compared to the net worth of financial ye ar 2023- 2024. The bidder to submit the documentary proof e.g. audited balance sheet, P&L accou nt etc. for the same or Net worth Certificate duly certified by practicing CA with me mbership number, seal, signed and UDIN number. In case the date of constitution/ incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 years old , the following will be applicable: · The Net Worth in each of these years should not be negative. · Net Worth in respect of the immediate previous financial year should not ha ve eroded more 30 per cent than that of its previously audited financial statement. In case the Bidder has completed financial statements of only preceding year, the clause of net worth erosion will not be applicable. All the financial documents submitted shall be in the name of firm/bidder only. 07. Copy PAN Details, GST Registration details, valid PF and ESIC registration details. 08. Submission of Integrity Pact (Annexure-XIII) of NIT with date and sign, stamp on e ach page .
